enemies: Many monsters in the Forthos Dungeon

st.t: Go to the Forthos Ruins, north-east of the Woodcutting Guild, and enter the Forthos Dungeon.
i: Knife or slash weapon to cut through a web

st.t: Cut through the web to the south and go to the south-east corner of the dungeon, outside the entrance to Sarachnis' lair. Use 5 pieces of food (fish, meat or vegetables) on Aimeri there.

st.t: Turn on Protect from Magic and run west along the long hallway to the room with the undead druids. Search the musty bookshelves there until you have the tomes of moon, sun and temple. Each tome is on a different bookshelf.
Kill any monsters in the Forthos Dungeon for pages for the tomes. You'll need to use 4 pages on each tome.
Give the tomes to Logosia in the Arceuus library.
